facts.big: What is in…? · Does it have…?
facts.label: Perguntar os ingredientes
facts.sub: Pergunte What is in this muffin? e responda It has flour and eggs. Para um ingrediente específico, use Does it have nuts? e No, it does not have nuts. Fale da alergia com I have an allergy to nuts.

facts.label: Alergias alimentares
facts.sub: Muitas pessoas nos EUA têm alergia a nozes, leite, ovos ou frutos do mar. Por isso restaurantes e padarias costumam perguntar sobre alergias e mostrar os ingredientes.

facts.label: Leia o rótulo
facts.sub: Os rótulos listam ingredientes e avisos como “contains milk”. Aprender essas palavras ajuda você a comprar com segurança em qualquer mercado.

pages.title: Is it safe? · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet Tuesday morning in a small bakery in Boston. Pat looks at the muffins behind the glass. He loves sweet food, but he has an allergy. Some foods can make him sick. Lena, the clerk, smiles from behind the counter. Pat takes a breath and asks about the ingredients.
“Hi! Can I help you?” says Lena. “Yes. What is in this muffin?” says Pat. “It has flour, eggs and butter.” says Lena.
